pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)In AE2, certain $(l:ae2_mechanics/devices)devices$(/l) and components can be placed on cables in the same block. This is useful for compact setups. Shift-right-clicking with a $(l:items_blocks_machines/wrench)Certus Quartz Wrench$(/l) or $(l:items_blocks_machines/network_tool)Network Tool$(/l) can break a single subpart (or the cable) off without breaking everything in that block.
